verdict.rationale: Apple's newsroom only claims in general marketing terms that M4 Pro speeds up building and testing apps in Xcode and handling large code bases. The pack documents no CPU core counts, no boost or clock behavior, and no independent multi-core benchmarks; the community items are only questions about comparative performance. Missing for 10: documented core counts, documented boost/frequency behavior, independent multi-core benchmark corroboration, concrete compile-time or parallel-workload figures.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compile big codebases and run heavy parallel jobs fast — documented core counts and boost behavior, corroborated by independent multi-core benchmarks

citations.quote: This huge boost in performance makes building and testing apps across multiple simulators in Xcode quicker than ever.
For professionals working on larger file sizes across AI, video, code bases, and more, M4 Pro offers stunning performance
